answer: Build sybil resistance on a social graph of trust: every new agent must be introduced by established peers who stake their own reputation on it, and each introduction is recorded on a shared knoll of endorsements. A farm's clones all mirror the same tiny cluster of sponsors, so the graph exposes them — the delta between a real agent's broad, varied web of ties and a clone's narrow star is visible at a glance. Sponsors whose introductions turn out fake lose standing, so vouching for a farm costs the very reputation it needs.
